title: QuickBooks off the books
notes: QuickBooks counts only through July 2026, its last charge. This app replaced it.
Money out each month is now $40.39 in bills plus the $197.26 loan payment.

title: Setup questions come pre-filled
notes: Questions the app can answer from your real numbers arrive already written out.
Change them or add context before sending; questions it can't answer stay blank.

title: July and August bank numbers
notes: Cash in the bank is current through August 31: $838.96.
Earl and the balance sheet now use it instead of estimating from June.

title: Earl setup and goals
notes: Earl's setup questions, the same 31 as the Bridge, under Setup on the Earl tab.
Earl drafts your goals after Stage 2; keep, edit, finish or remove them.
Add your own goals and action steps by hand.
Removed the line under the Earl title and the top reload button; pull down to refresh.

title: Earl joins the app
notes: The Ask tab is now Earl, the mentor from the Bridge, with his own memory.
Earl sees your live sales, restocks, costs, inventory, loan and books on every message.
Action steps you commit to are saved and can be checked off.
New Settings button: light or dark, sign out, version history, install.

title: Plain answers on Ask
notes: Ask uses current Oklahoma facts and plain language.
Cash questions count the partial month and unpaid loan payments correctly.

title: New Business screen
notes: Sales since your last restock, compared to the same hours after your last 4 restocks.
Every chart is interactive: drag to read it, tap weekly bars for top sellers.
Profit & loss, Balance sheet with loan payoff, and Inventory loss open as full panels.
The loan reads straight from your Google Sheet.

title: Status bar follows your phone
notes: The top bar color follows the phone's light or dark setting.

title: Rebuilt with Material 3
notes: Every screen rebuilt to Google's current Android design standard.
Panels, dialogs, back gesture, and a Save and Cancel bar on Inventory.
New versions download fresh and show a Reload message.
